body_edits.new: If you publish the source page, Google's guidance read on 2 November 2026 documents a worldwide participation setting in Search Console, alongside crawl and preview controls.
body_edits.old: If you publish the source page, Google documents crawl and preview controls for how its content can appear in Search, plus a France-specific participation control.

body_edits.new: Google's current [Search generative AI control help](https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/16908024), read on 2 November 2026, describes Include and Exclude settings for participation in AI Overviews, AI Mode and generative features in Discover. A child property can inherit a parent setting. The control concerns content and links in those features; it does not change ordinary Search ranking or stand in for a separate training control. The [July France announcement](https://blog.google/intl/fr-fr/nouveautes-produits/explorez-obtenez-des-r%25C3%25A9ponses/recherche-ia-apercus-mode/) remains a historical rollout source.
body_edits.old: Google's [22 July France announcement](https://blog.google/intl/fr-fr/nouveautes-produits/explorez-obtenez-des-r%25C3%25A9ponses/recherche-ia-apercus-mode/) separately reports a Search Console control available in France for participation in generative Search features. It says this is not a ranking signal outside those features. **Reasoned.** That country-specific statement should not be expanded into a worldwide account feature.

description.new: Search Console documents worldwide participation settings for generative Search features. Crawl, preview and training controls have different scopes.
description.old: Publisher preview controls differ from turning off an Overview as a reader. Google also reports a France-specific control.
